handbookNote: Official Code of Georgia Annotated (O.C.G.A.) Title 45, Chapter 17 (Notaries Public) -- notaries are commissioned at the county level by the Clerk of Superior Court, not a Secretary of State; as of January 1, 2025, O.C.G.A. Section 45-17-8(h) requires all new and renewing notaries to complete GSCCCA-administered training, with no separate written exam. Priced at $0.99 (2026-08-16 directive): GA has no graded assessment (statute explicitly says 'no separate exam'), so this is education-only practice content, not exam prep -- priced accordingly, well below the $9.99 exam-state tier.
